Compression may render pages into image-backed PDF pages. This can make scanned or image-heavy documents much smaller, but may remove selectable text, annotations, forms, links, metadata, and layers. Always check exported files before deleting originals.

Scanned PDFs are image-backed documents created from camera captures. Watermarks and signatures are visual marks added to a new PDF copy on your device. They are not certificate-based digital signatures.

How much time do you have left?

Real-time display of your remaining years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, and seconds. Every millisecond reminds you: time waits for no one.

Set 0-10 daily reminders to keep death's shadow ever-present.

【PHILOSOPHY】

The ancient Romans said: Memento Mori (Remember you will die).

This isn't about fear—it's about appreciation. Only when you realize life is finite will you start taking each day seriously.

"Not only greedy, but naive" — if you think you'll live to 80.
Death makes no appointments. Tomorrow is not guaranteed.

【WHO IS THIS FOR】

• Chronic procrastinators
• Phone addicts
• Those searching for life's meaning
• People who want change but lack motivation
• Everyone who will eventually die (that's everyone)

Download now. Start your countdown.

Because you are dying soon.
